page.layout: One page of running text in one column. Running head "TRIUMPHUS" at the top, centred. Page number at the top left. Theses numbered II to V in the text block. Marginal line numbers (10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35) and a section mark (§) in the right margin. A bare reference "cap. 3." in italics below the last line, at the right.

main_text.p: II. Philosophia vera est theoretica, vel practica. Hæc diuisio lucem accipit ex celebri isto Vrim & Thummim Exod. 28. vers. 30. Nam Vrim, id est, lucus, significat lumen intellectus: Thummim, id est, perfectiones siue integritates,§ significat rectitudinem voluntatis. Verus itaq; philosophus est, qui coniungit Vrim & Thummim. Idē iudicium est de theologo, medico & iurisconsulto: qui omnes ita debent instituere actiones suas, ut congruant ad Vrim & Thummim.10

III. Philosophia theoretica docet rectam contemplationem operum, siue magnaliū, Dei, ita nimirum, vt ex operibus istis colligat, Deum esse, & esse potentem, æternum &c. Rom. 1. vers. 19. 20. Hoc est, quod Plato docuit, gratissimam de Deo famam in artibus esse sparsam.15
IV. Philosophia practica docet rectum vsum legis naturæ, Rom. 2. vers. 14. 15. Ita nimirum, vt homi-nem contineat in officio iustitiæ vniuersalis, cuius dicta-men impressum est cordibus nostris.20

V. Philosophia falsa est, quæ vel obscurat legem siue lumen naturæ, vel se opponit lumini gratiæ siue euangelio. De priori abusu vide Rom. 1. v. 21. & seqq. de posteriori 1. Cor. 1. vers. 20. 26. & c. 2. v. 1. 4.6.13. Act. 17. vers. 18. Vbi fit mentio philosophorum Epi-25cureorum & Stoicorum, qui Paulo bellum indixerunt. Confer Coloss. 2, v. 8. vbi apostolus ait: Videte, ne quis vos decipiat per philosophiam & inanem fallaciam, secundum traditionem hominum, secundum elementa mundi, & non secundum Christum. Hunc apostoli locum explanans Tertullianus lib.30 de præscriptionibus aduersus hæreticos cap. 7. dicit, apostolum fuisse Athenis, & istam sapientiam humanam, affectatricem, & interpolatricem veritatis, de congressibus no-35uisse, ipsam quoque in suas hæreses multipartitam va-rietate sectarum inuicem repugnantium. Idem de animacap. 3.

page.notes: The marginal numbers 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 and 35 are printed line counts in the right margin and are kept as notes. The section mark (§) is a printed mark in the margin. The page number "11" is uncertain; it may read "ii" or "11". The "cap. 3." at the foot is a bare reference, placed here as a note. The printed "verf." is read as "vers." (long s). Printed word-spacing in "Huncapostoli" is normalised to "Hunc apostoli". No catchword or signature is printed.
